Capabilities: - 🩺 Resume Diagnosis: 5-dimensional scoring (format/content/keywords/quantified results/ATS-friendliness) with red-yellow-green triage report - 💊 Achievement Rewriting: Transforms "responsible for X" into "Led a 5-person team to deliver Project X in Q3, boosting conversion by 23%" — auto-applies STAR method - 🎯 Job Targeting: Paste a target JD, extract keywords, reorder experience by relevance, push match rate from 40% to 85%+ - 🔥 Keyword Injection: Scans industry keyword banks (Tech/Finance/Manufacturing/Corporate) and fills ATS-critical gaps - 📋 Template First Aid: Detects template issues (misalignment, font chaos, overflow) and provides fixes - 🌐 Bilingual: Supports both English CV/Resume and Chinese 简历 diagnosis and optimization   When to use: - "Review my resume", "resume critique", "is my resume good enough" - "Tailor this resume for this job", "optimize for this JD" - "Not getting interviews", "why am I getting rejected" - "Help me write a summary", "how to quantify my experience" - "ATS-friendly resume", "beat the bots", "pass ATS" - "Resume too long", "one-page resume", "executive summary"
